transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

I’m here because I can’t seem to keep my mind on one thing anymore. At work, I’ll be at the bench and I’ll jump from a customer email to a saw mark, then some noise outside catches me, and then I realize I’ve lost track of the whole work order. It’s starting to mess with my work.
Do you often feel restless, fidgety, or have trouble staying seated, especially when you're trying to focus on a task?

Yeah, I do. At the bench I can’t really sit still like I used to. I’ll start sketching a new watch case, then get up and email suppliers, then start rearranging the display trays even after closing. It’s like I keep moving from one thing to the next.
